problem_type: When the paid card was closed while one of its shots was still being approved, the Agent's receipt and the card's closing notice were read before that approval landed, so a shot that was then approved, sent and paid for was reported as not generated
symptom: Breaker acceptance of #947 at 2e37960e6, fixture vendor (2026-10-02). X2: press Generate this one on a 3-shot card, then × right away; the × reached the host 4.7 seconds later (main process busy). The vendor received shot 1 and its image landed, but the Agent's receipt said 'Not generated and nothing spent for shot-1, shot-2, shot-3: the user closed the card', and no notice said anything was sent. X4: press Generate remaining 6 and × in the middle; the notice and the vendor both said 3 shots, but the receipt counted only 2 as generating and said shot 3 cost nothing, while it had been paid for and had landed.
direct_cause: electron/capabilityCore/appIntegrationSpendConfirm.ts discardPendingSpend withdrew the offer and, in its finally, handed the decision to the waiting turn at once; the turn then read the per-shot outcome immediately. The × is deliberately not queued, so it could land while confirmOneShot for shot k had passed the card's checks but not yet sealed its gate: the withdraw found no gate to revoke, the outcome read at that moment had shot k undecided, and shot k was then sealed, approved and sent. The × also returned no count, so a stopped single Generate this one showed no notice at all.
class_root: The outcome of a presentation was read the moment it was closed, by whoever closed it, while a card action that decides spend could still be in flight in the card's queue. The queue lived inside createPendingSpendActions, so the other closer (the lane's withdraw when the user types while the card is open, followed by readPresentationOutcome) could not wait for it either.
affected_population: Everyone who presses × on the paid card while a shot is being approved (a single Generate this one, or Generate remaining): the Agent is told a paid shot was not generated, and may offer to generate it again
Everyone who types into the Agent panel while a Generate this one is being approved: same wrong receipt through the lane's redirected path
entry_points: The card's 取消: useAgentPanelSpendCard.discard -> IPC discard-spend -> appIntegrationSpendConfirm.discardPendingSpend -> generation.withdrawPresentation -> answer from generationPresentationOutcome
Typing while the card is open: laneExtendedDesktopPorts (redirected) -> withdrawPresentation -> readPresentationOutcome
The card closing because every shot is handed over or removed: settlePresentation (handed_to_canvas) -> watchSpendCardClose waits for the hand-overs to settle -> receipt
internal_only_reason: When a paid card's outcome is final, and who may read it, is Nomi's own spend-authority flow; no external protocol defines it.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The ledger is the one linearization point: hand-over, bind, settle and close are ledger commands; after a close a bind is refused, queued consents are withdrawn, and in-flight hand-overs write their own settlement. The outcome is read only through generationPresentationOutcome, and the lane waits for the settlement before reading it.

invariants: The receipt the Agent gets after the card closes lists as generating exactly the shots handed to the provider or still being handed over, including one whose hand-over was in flight when the card was closed; a shot whose result is unknown is never reported as not charged.
The card's 取消 answers with the ledger's count (sent / not sent) for this presentation, and the card's notice says that count.

Closing the card is never queued behind the action it interrupts; the lane reads the outcome only after the hand-overs it waits on have settled (or the wait has timed out, when the ones still in flight count as generating).

door_reduction.why_not: The in-memory queue and its wait are gone; the ledger is the one linearization point. The write doors are the hand-over commands (bind, settle) and the canvas side that issues them; the read doors are the tellers of the result (the card answer, the operation view, the two lane readers, the policy wait), all reading generationPresentationOutcome.

generality_proof: Nothing depends on the model, vendor, shot kind, batch size or who closes the card: every closer (取消, typing, every shot decided) and every card action (Generate, 不生成 ×, restore) is a ledger command, and every teller of a final result reads generationPresentationOutcome.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Writes each handed-over shot's settlement (accepted / unknown / not_sent / withdrawn) into the presentation that handed it over, found by canvasRunId across presentations; closing the card records unbound hand-overs as withdrawn in the same command.

The only reader of a presentation's final per-shot outcome: generating (approved, sent, unknown, handing over), failed before sending, removed, undecided. The card's answer, the Agent's receipt and the operation view all read it.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Withdraws through the ledger and answers from generationPresentationOutcome (agentPanelSpendCardStop.e2e.test.ts: 取消 with 0, 1 and 3 in flight; × before the bind).
Waits for unsettled hand-overs before the receipt is read (laneSpendCardClose.test.ts).

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: redirected (typing while the card is open)
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Closes through withdrawPresentation and reads readPresentationOutcome, which reads generationPresentationOutcome (agentPanelSpendCardStop.e2e.test.ts user_wrote).

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: operation view presentationOutcome (external MCP read / status)
same_class_entry_points.evidence: A polled read model over the same projection: a read during a hand-over shows the shot handing over and the next read shows its settlement.

recurrence.reason: Any new way of closing the card, or any new reader of the outcome, can again read before an in-flight hand-over lands; the ledger commands and the one reader are what keep that from coming back.
same_class_scan: rg "withdrawPresentation|operations.withdraw" electron -> discardPendingSpend, laneExtendedDesktopPorts (redirected, stopped, no window), stalePresentationSweep (startup)

prevention.invariant: A presentation's final outcome is read from the ledger after its hand-overs have settled; every close path closes through the ledger, after which a late bind is refused.
prevention.failure_mode: If a hand-over never settles (the renderer is gone mid-dispatch), the lane's wait times out and the shot is reported as generating (it may have been charged), never as not sent.
prevention.strategy: Record hand-over, bind and settle as ledger commands, make a close refuse later binds, and read the outcome only through generationPresentationOutcome; the in-memory arbiter is deleted.

legacy_paths.rationale: 2026-10-24: spendOperationArbiter (serializeCardAction / sealedOutcome / cardActionsSettled) is deleted with the old card's host actions; the ledger is the linearization point.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency orders the card's actions.

migration: No stored data changes; the queue is in memory and empty after a restart (the startup sweep withdraws a presentation left open). 2026-10-24 D2 step 3 (design card docs/plan/2026-10-23-d2-pointer-spend-card.md; contract docs/fixes/2026-10-24-spend-card-one-engine.root-cause.json): the paid card became node pointers plus a read-only summary that hands its shots to the canvas engine; spendOperationArbiter (serializeCardAction / sealedOutcome) was deleted with the old card, so this contract's boundaries, doors, tests and legacy paths were re-pointed to the code that holds the invariant today (problem, symptom, causes and class root above are the original record).
residual_risks: If the renderer disappears between the consent and the dispatch, a bound hand-over is settled from the canvas Run's job (accepted / unknown / not sent); until then the lane's wait times out after 15 s and reports it as generating.
